title: The Human Before the World
author: Ethan James Farrell
description: A custom study prepared with OpenAI Codex (September 2026): The Human Before the World: Anthropos and Adam Kadmon in the Mystical Imagination of Creation, subtitled a study in light, likeness and the destiny of the soul. It contemplates the humanity imagined at the threshold of creation in ancient Gnostic writings and Jewish mysticism. Chapters move from the human likeness in the fullness of light and the image reflected in the waters, through other heavens and other humans and the tension between likeness and the unimaginable, to Adam Kadmon and the measure of light, the shattering of the vessels and the work of return, and a conversation between the two cosmologies. Further sections treat the heavenly human in the Secret Book of John (Apocryphon of John) and Adam Kadmon's first configurations. Reflective rather than technical, it belongs with the library's cluster of primordial-human studies.
